archetypes.name: orchestration
archetypes.rationale: The voting-protocol.md change removes direct Claude-voter launch from orchestrator and delegates to dispatch-plan-voters.sh; verify that script actually implements the Claude lane and that the behavioral change is safe.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the voting-protocol.md changes that move Claude voter dispatch from an inline 'Agent tool' call to dispatch-plan-voters.sh. Verify that dispatch-plan-voters.sh actually supports launching a Claude voter lane and that no existing orchestrator code paths in skills/ or scripts/ were relying on the old direct-launch instruction. Check whether the removal of 'Claude replacement voters when external unavailable' language for plan review changes fall-back behavior in degraded (no Codex/Cursor) scenarios. Also review the SKILL.md Step 2b drafter block to confirm the new emit-design-plan-preview.sh call site and the _repo_root capture are correctly ordered relative to set +e/-e boundaries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-robustness
archetypes.rationale: Several bash correctness details deserve scrutiny: git rev-parse outside set+e, LARCH_QUIET_DISABLE=1 env passthrough, printf format string change, and sleep 1 in tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: In skills/design/SKILL.md, the new `_repo_root` line runs `git -C "$PWD" rev-parse --show-toplevel` before `set +e`; if this fails (detached HEAD, non-repo directory), it would abort the entire fence block. Confirm whether that is the intended failure mode. In emit-design-plan-preview.sh, the old `printf '%s\n' "$_outline"` used a literal newline in the format string; the new form uses `\n` — verify these are semantically identical and no trailing-newline behavior changed. Check that `LARCH_QUIET_DISABLE=1` being prepended to the emit-design-plan-preview.sh call in SKILL.md is appropriate given the lib-quiet.md contract and does not suppress any diagnostics callers rely on. In the test, `sleep 1` is used to establish mtime ordering for freshness; assess fragility on fast filesystems where sub-second mtime resolution could cause a race. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-coverage
archetypes.rationale: Multiple documentation files updated; verify cross-doc consistency and that no callers of emit-design-plan-preview.sh or token-ledger are left with stale references.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that all references to emit-design-plan-preview.sh in SKILL.md, .md companion docs, and test scripts consistently reflect the step2b variant addition (usage string, --variant enum, ⚠ prefix wording). Verify that the token-ledger.md `claude_draft` addition is consistent with any enum consumers in token-report.sh or other scripts that parse the `raw=` field. Confirm that the emit-design-plan-preview.md companion accurately describes the step2b graceful-degrade contract (warning prefix `⚠ 2b:`, exit 0, allowlist check order) as implemented in the .sh. Check whether the large-plan note for step2b deliberately omits the 'See full plan' prompt wording and that this intent is captured in the .md and tests. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
